chunks: Ali ibn Ibrahim, from his father, from Al-Hasan ibn Mahboub, from Muqatil ibn Suleyman, who said:

I asked Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him): 'What was the height of Adam (peace be upon him) when he was descended to the earth, and what was the height of Hawwa (peace be upon her)?' He (peace be upon him) said: 'We found in the Book of Ali ibn Abu Talib (peace be upon him) that when Allah, the Mighty and Majestic, descended Adam and his wife Hawwa (peace be upon her) to the earth, his feet were at the twin peaks of Al-Safa and his head was below the horizon of the sky. And he complained to Allah from the heat of the sun that was befalling him. So Allah, the Mighty and Majestic, revealed to Jibraeel (peace be upon him):
ai.seo_question: What was the original height of Adam and Hawwa before they were compressed on earth?
ai.summary: This narration from *Al-Kafi* highlights the primordial grandeur of Adam (AS) by linking his physical dimensions to the sacred geography of Mecca, specifically Mount Safa, thereby establishing a theological connection between the first human and the holiest site in Islam. It further illustrates the divine mercy in adjusting human physiology to earthly conditions, as recorded in the *Kitab Ali* tradition, emphasizing the transition from a celestial to a terrestrial existence.

en.hubeali: H 14756 – Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, from Al-Hassan Bin Mahboub, from Muqatil Bin Suleyman who said:

I asked Abu Abdullahasws, ‘What was the length of Adamas when heas descended to the earth, and what was the length of Hawwaas?’ Heasws said: ‘Weasws found in the Book of Aliasws Bin Abu Talibasws that when Allahazwj Made Adamas and hisas wife Hawwaas to the earth, hisas legs were in its twin part of Al-Safa (Al-Marwa), and hisas head was under the horizon of the sky, and heas complained to Allahazwj from the difficulty caused by the heat of the sun. So Allahazwj Mighty and Majestic Revealed unto Jibraeelas that Adamas had complained from the difficulty caused from the heat of the Sun. So he compressed himas with a compression and hisas length became of seventy cubits, and he compressed Hawwaas with a compression, so heras length became of thirty five cubits’.
en.sarwar: 308. Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, from Al-Hassan Bin Mahboub, from Muqatil Bin Suleyman who said:

I asked Abu Abdullah (a.s.), ‘What was the length of Adam (as) when he (as) descended to the earth, and what was the length of Hawwa (as)?’ He (a.s.) said: ‘We (a.s.) found in the Book of Ali (a.s.) Bin Abu Talib (a.s.) that when Allah (azwj) Made Adam (as) and his (as) wife Hawwa (as) to the earth, his (as) legs were in its twin part of Al-Safa (Al-Marwa), and his (as) head was under the horizon of the sky, and he (as) complained to Allah (azwj) from the difficulty caused by the heat of the sun. So Allah (azwj) Mighty and Majestic Revealed unto Jibraeel (as) that Adam (as) had complained from the difficulty caused from the heat of the Sun. So he compressed him (as) with a compression and his (as) length became of seventy cubits, and he compressed Hawwa (as) with a compression, so her (as) length became of thirty five cubits’.
